label: Interpretability and explainability
description: Methods or evaluations whose main contribution explains model predictions, reveals how learned representations or internal mechanisms work, or measures the faithfulness and usefulness of model explanations. Merely describing a method or visualizing results is not sufficient.

label: World models
description: Learning models of environment dynamics that predict future states or observations, including action-conditioned simulation and models used for planning or control. Static scene reconstruction, recognition, and generic image generation alone are not sufficient.
